change.source: Exit after SIGTERM with another session's transaction open: 8.0 s on the base, 40-141 ms after; with an events read under way 6.04 s -> 71 ms. 20 of 20 separate nextest runs of a_leader_exits_within_the_bound_under_an_open_transaction green (each about 9.4 s, standby took the lease 97-199 ms after the exit).
